desktop:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: distinctive homepage hero illustration for Vento Systems, an interdisciplinary deep technology company. Premium editorial 3D sculpture about disciplines becoming one working system. Create one extraordinarily elegant engineered weave, not a literal machine or a logo.
Subject: a single low, wide interlocking architectural form. A broad matte charcoal structural band rises, bends with a beautifully machined radius, and returns into an open bridge-like loop. Three thin warm-ivory ceramic laminations pass smoothly through its open center and fan apart slightly toward one side, held within the graphite structure. A single narrow satin copper-orange inlay follows the flowing route continuously through the construction, making connection tangible. Beautifully resolved intersections, purposeful joinery, subtle ribbed side sections, precise bevels, realistic wall thickness, no impossible self-intersections. One coherent object, a clear memorable horizontal silhouette, a large open negative space, no small surrounding props. Conceptually: information, intelligence and physical structure woven together.
Style: exceptionally refined industrial-design editorial art, photorealistic tactile materials, calm and sculptural, restrained sophistication. Charcoal ceramic-coated metal, warm ivory porcelain-like satin surfaces, burnt orange copper accent, crisp edges, beautiful subtle contact shadows. Mostly black and ivory, copper less than 8%. Bright enough to read immediately at phone size, no murky black-on-black surfaces.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas, a close three-quarter front perspective with a slightly elevated camera, almost orthographic, entire sculpture visible, centered and occupying 83% of width and 62% of height. One continuous sculptural gesture with a width-to-height near 2.3:1. Dark seamless warm-charcoal studio floor and background matching #171510, edges quiet and almost uniform, soft top-left key and restrained warm rimlight, no spotlit box edges. No pedestal or stage. High-end art-direction and beautiful material separation, sharp craftsmanship, no excessive ornament.
Avoid: V shapes, letters, words, logo, text, digits, captions, watermark, arrows, infinity logo, torus, AI brain, neural network, orb, glass sphere, floating UI, computer screens, humanoid robot, camera, actuator, server, circuit board, factory equipment, gold/brass steampunk, ornate screws, neon, bloom, holograms, wires, collages, orange background. Deliver only the finished artwork.
compact: Use case: precise-object-edit. The input is the approved hero artwork to preserve, not just inspiration. Create the compact mobile composition of exactly this same engineered-weave sculpture. Change only camera framing/canvas: make a wide landscape image with 2.3:1 aspect ratio. Keep the entire sculpture visible including both end tips, with 6% dark breathing room at left and right and modest top/bottom clearance. The full object must occupy about 88% width and 82% height so it reads clearly at 350×152 CSS pixels. Keep the existing graphite curved structure, all three ivory flowing laminations, copper inlay, ribbing, exact interlocking geometry, materials, lighting and three-quarter angle unchanged. The same seamless dark warm-charcoal #171510 studio background, no new objects, no text, no logo. Preserve the sculptural negative space and visible contact shadows. Deliver only this compact landscape artwork.
